Keep tracking with the screen off
So your group keeps seeing you — screen off, app closed, even after your phone restarts — set these two things. Tap a button to jump to GroundLink's settings, then follow the steps.
1
Location → Allow all the time
On the settings page that opens:
 1.  Tap Permissions
 2.  Tap Location
 3.  Choose Allow all the time — not "While using the app"
2
Battery → Unrestricted
On the settings page that opens:
 1.  Tap Battery
 2.  Choose Unrestricted (or "Don't optimize")
 3.  Samsung phones: also turn off Pause app activity if unused
You're in the Crew
This room is a Crew. That means your location is shared with everyone in it continuously — not just while you have the app open.
  • You stay on the map even when the app is closed or your phone is locked.
  • You keep showing up here even when you're in a different room.
  • Everyone else in the Crew is shared with you the same way.
You can leave at any time — My Crews on the home screen, then the ✕ next to this Crew.

Where to find maps
Download a georeferenced geoPDF, then tap Import a map to overlay it. USGS & USFS PDFs are georeferenced; most park/WMA brochure PDFs are not (they won't auto-align).
USGS topoView
Browse the map, tap any quad, download the geoPDF. Best all-around source.
The National Map — Downloader
USGS US Topo geoPDFs for the whole country, filter by area.
FWC WMA brochures
Florida hunting-area maps (note: mostly plain PDFs, not georeferenced).
FWC GeoData portal
WMA boundaries & layers (GeoJSON/KML/GeoTIFF).
Map Layers
Base Map
Offline maps
Save aerial imagery for an area to use with no signal. USGS imagery, ~200 MB cap.
Overlays
Weather Radar
NWS NEXRAD · last 2 hours, animated

Location & sharing
Share my location
Turn off to stay in the room & chat, but hide your spot on the map
ON
Hide this device from others
For a tablet or spare phone. It keeps sharing so YOU can still find it, but it won't show on anyone else's map — in any group.
OFF
Name this device
Shown after your name as “You · tablet”, so your phone and tablet are tellable apart. This names the DEVICE — your own name stays the same everywhere.
phone
Share my speed
Let the group see your speed while driving (over 25 mph)
ON
Announce when I join
Notify members & your favorites when you enter this room. Off = join quietly.
ON
Battery saver
When you sit still a while, ease off GPS & send a slow heartbeat. Moving wakes it instantly.
ON
Keep my trail
Record where you go so you and your Crew can look back on any day (kept 30 days)
OFF
Voice & devices
Voice (push-to-talk)
Show the Talk button to start walkie-talkie voice with members
ON
Advanced
Auto-listen to my devices
Hear your watch from any screen without tapping Talk, and get an alert when it talks. Active while the app is open.
ON
Show my devices on every map
Always show your private devices (like the watch) on every group map. Off = only on My Map, or where you turn it on per-room.
OFF
Hear others on the device channel
On = you also hear family members talking to your device (e.g. the watch). Off = you only hear the device itself.
ON
Keep car radio on (voice)
Stops a vehicle's Bluetooth from treating push-to-talk as a phone call & muting the radio. Turn off if voice audio sounds wrong.
ON
Live voice with my crew
On = hear & talk to your crew live, automatically, like a walkie-talkie. Off = you just get a notification when someone talks.
ON
Status icons while tracking
Background voice & location keep working either way — this only controls whether Android shows a status-bar icon while they run. Off by default.
OFF
Background location
Keep updating your dot when the app is closed. Turning this off removes the status-bar icon — you'll only update while the app is open.
ON
Background tracking
Keep sharing when your screen is off — tap to set up
CHECK ›
Restart the app
Fixes background tracking that's stopped updating. A normal reload can't — this ends the app completely.
›
Screen stays awake automatically while tracking.
